postconditions.expression: any(output_exists(t, output_exists(k, output_exists(route, t == 'Yes' and k >= 0 and route == [str(i) for i in range(1, n+1)]))) for t, k, route in outputs)
postconditions.description: There exists an output where the King can travel along a route that matches the required flag colors for all cities.

postconditions.expression: any(output_exists(t, output_exists(k, output_exists(route, t == 'Yes' and k == len(route) and all(route[i] == str(i+1) for i in range(k))))) for t, k, route in outputs)
postconditions.description: The shortest route found for the King is the one that visits all cities exactly once.

postconditions.expression: any(output_exists(t, output_exists(k, output_exists(route, t == 'No'))) for t, k, route in outputs)
postconditions.description: There exists an output where the King cannot find a route that matches the required flag colors for all cities.
